title: Geometric Protection of Bipartite Entanglement in Hopf-Linked Quantum Rings
summary: We determine the bipartite entanglement bounds of two interacting electrons in deeply interlocked Hopf-linked quantum rings via exact diagonalization of the unexpanded 3D Coulomb interaction. This identifies an exact continuous spatial symmetry that geometrically isolates the positive-parity Bell state, preventing classical interaction-driven localization. A non-coplanar geometric tilt ($α> 0$) is essential to lift the exchange degeneracy and maintain this maximally entangled manifold as a state of frozen entanglement.
